title: SZOps: Scalar Operations for Error-bounded Lossy Compressor for Scientific Data
problem: Existing error-bounded lossy compressors do not support computational operations on compressed data, requiring costly complete decompression before any computation. Scientific HPC applications need to perform operations on compressed datasets without incurring full decompression overhead.
motivation: HPC scientific simulations generate massive datasets requiring compression with controlled distortion, but current approaches force decompression overhead when users need to perform computations.
method: SZOps extends error-bounded lossy compression to support direct scalar operations (negation, addition, multiplication, mean, variance) on compressed data without decompression. The system develops optimization strategies to maximize overall compression ratio and execution performance while maintaining error bounds in the compressed domain.
key_novelty: First error-bounded lossy compressor that enables efficient scalar operations directly on compressed data without requiring complete decompression.
contributions: Novel error-bounded lossy compression framework (SZOps) supporting direct operations on compressed data
Optimization strategies for maximizing compression ratio and execution performance
Support for multiple scalar operations including negation, addition, multiplication, mean, and variance
Comprehensive evaluation against state-of-the-art compressors on real-world scientific datasets
limitations: Not discussed in abstract; specific baseline systems and quantitative performance metrics not provided.
primary_theme: In-situ operations on error-bounded compressed data
